# FDG7011

> AVOID explicitly throwing exceptions from finally blocks. Implicitly thrown exceptions resulting from calling methods that throw are acceptable.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.1 Exception Throwing.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA2219
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

CA2219 reports a throw statement in a finally clause; exceptions thrown by called methods are not reported, which the text accepts. CA2219 has no code fix.

## From the book

This section covered the general issues on throwing exceptions. The next section deals with deciding which type of exception to throw.
